Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The activation conditions include paying 1 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 3 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 1 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 1 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 3 Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Main] By paying 1 and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or level 3 Digimon, that Digimon gets +2000 DP until your opponent's turn ends.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When effects add to this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
